0.name: ACS 5-Year 2024, table S1901 — median household income by census tract
0.note: On disk. The libraries case reads the same file. Only the census-tract layer carries a true median; NTA and community district carry a population-weighted mean of tract medians.

1.name: NYPD complaints, year to date 2026, pulled 2026-06-29
1.note: 133,114 complaints, every one geocoded. Severity weights felony 3, misdemeanor 2, violation 1, the same as scripts/pairwise_socioeconomic_regression.py. Crime is point data, so a count and an area aggregate exactly. Thus every layer gets a true value, unlike the income proxy.

2.name: ACS 5-Year 2024, table B01003 — total population by census tract
2.note: Weights the income aggregation, and supplies the denominator of the per-capita crime rate. A sum aggregates exactly, so the population of a polygon needs no approximation.
